summary: This is a routine Form 6-K filing by AXIA Energia S.A., a Brazilian electric services foreign private issuer, for the month of June 2026. The filing contains only a signature page, standard boilerplate forward-looking statements, and a placeholder graphic. No special-situation transaction or material corporate event is disclosed such as a merger, acquisition, spin-off, restructuring, tender offer, delisting, or activist campaign. The registrant simply meets its periodic reporting obligation under the Securities Exchange Act of 1934. This is an ordinary current report with no actionable event. Accordingly, it does not qualify as any special-situation category.
